entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, Sarah... I hope you can help. I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-886-2154. It's about a jersey I bought. I've been a loyal customer for years, and this has never happened before.
Thank you. I see the order for the Pro-Vent jersey. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's the wrong size. I followed the size chart, but when it arrived, it's just way too tight. I can barely zip it up. I saved up for it, and I was so excited... I just feel really let down.

I understand how frustrating that must be. Let me just check the delivery date here... Okay, I see it was delivered 47 days ago. Our policy for standard items like this jersey is a 90-day return window.
Oh, so I can return it? I was so worried I'd be stuck with it, and I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to work.
Yes, absolutely. You are well within the timeframe. We can process a full refund for you, or if you'd like, we can do an exchange for the next size up. Whatever works best for you.
Oh, that's wonderful news! Thank you so much, Sarah. I think I would like to do an exchange, please. I really do love the design.

I'm happy we could sort that out for you. I've just initiated the exchange process. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to your email address on file right now. Just pack the jersey back in its original packaging, apply the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we see the return has been scanned, we'll ship out the new size to you immediately.
That's perfect. You've really turned my day around. Thank you for being so helpful.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
Great. Have a wonderful day, and thank you for being a VeloFit customer.
